svg.title: SciCode cap hits: question-level and run-level analysis

cc:Work.dc:title: SciCode cap hits: question-level and run-level analysis
cc:Work.dc:description: Retrospective SciCode cap-hit comparison on the same 294 retained subtasks and saved responses, excluding all 44 recovery-training subtasks. Repetitions increase from one to twenty, reaching 5880 responses per model. Blue diamonds show exact one-sided paired-subtask permutation p-values, keeping repetitions together within each subtask; green circles show one-sided Welch t-test p-values across per-repetition cap-hit rates. Welch is unavailable with one repetition. The question-level test first reaches p below 0.001 at three repetitions (882 responses/model); the run-level test at six repetitions (1764 responses/model). Horizontal lines mark 0.05 and 0.001. Independent subtasks and the respective test assumptions are required; these crossings are not validated stopping rules.
